items.descriptionEn: Configurable DSH-native LLM verifier plugin: pairwise comparison, pivot tournament selection, progress tracking and auto-acceptance gating (verifier_compare/select/track/current_session) with A-T scale scoring and a Web settings page.

items.name: 本地模型接入
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ollama 接入：模型管理、健康检查、基于规则的本地路由与云端回退。
items.descriptionEn: Ollama provider for DeepSeek Harness with model management, health checks, rule-based local routing and cloud fallback.

items.name: 全盘文件搜索
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 为 DSH 提供自建跨平台索引的全盘文件名搜索，带 agent 工具和 Web 面板，不依赖 Everything：默认索引主目录，首次内容搜索时在本机建全文索引（SQLite，系统缓存目录），引擎是随包的预编译 Go 程序，插件不发任何网络请求。
items.descriptionEn: Whole-disk file-name search for DSH with a self-built cross-platform index, agent tools and a Web panel; no Everything required. It indexes your home directory by default; the first content search also builds a local full-text index (SQLite in the platform cache directory) of text and source files there (by extension, up to 1 MB each, 200,000 files) and of your recent DSH session messages; locator_export writes a SQLite copy of the index to any absolute path it is given, replacing an existing file when overwrite is true. The engine is a prebuilt Go binary shipped for six platforms (source in engine/), and the plugin makes no network requests.

items.name: dsh-logo-golden
items.author: devzer0o0
items.description: HDR 黄金 SSR 大肥鱼：把侧栏的鲸鱼、deepseek 字标与 HARNESS 铭牌重绘为抛光黄金材质，并有一道斜向金属光带每三秒完整掠过整个组合。光带按原始矢量生成的几何遮罩判定受光面，暗金笔画与铭牌底板都会反光，铭文与镂空保持不亮；画布走 rgba16float 扩展动态范围，光芯短时峰值瞄准 1600 nit。
items.descriptionEn: HDR gold SSR whale lockup: redraws the sidebar whale, deepseek wordmark and HARNESS plate in polished gold, with a diagonal metal sweep that crosses the whole lockup every three seconds. A geometric mask built from the original vectors decides what is lit, so the dark end of the gold ramp and the plate reflect while the lettering and counters stay dark; the canvas runs rgba16float extended range with a 1600 nit short-time peak at the core.

items.name: LSP 动作
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 基于真实语言服务器的 LSP 动作面：诊断、格式化、补全、代码操作、符号、签名帮助、内联提示与重命名。
items.descriptionEn: LSP action surface over real language servers: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints and rename.

items.name: 本地长期记忆
items.author: tr1v3r
items.description: 基于本地 SQLite 的结构化长期记忆：CJK 感知检索、BM25 与字符 n-gram 余弦相似度混合重排，支持去重、更新、合并、确认与过期复核，以及全局和项目作用域；通过 agent 工具与 CLI 共用同一存储引擎，无需云端服务或 embedding 依赖。
items.descriptionEn: Structured long-term memory in local SQLite: CJK-aware search with hybrid BM25 and character n-gram cosine reranking, deduplication, updates, merging, confirmation and staleness review, plus global and project scopes. Agent tools and a CLI share one storage engine, with no cloud service or embedding dependency required.

items.name: Man！花了这么多钱！
items.author: gongfpp
items.description: 每轮结束弹出科比冰红茶人物，离线播报本轮费用或 Token 用量；按金额切换四档情绪语音，人民币与美元各十档常用金额用整句录音播报（共 400 条）。装了 dsh-cost-meter 时优先用它的结果，否则按各请求原生用量与公开单价估算并标明是估算。含二十句金额台词、四句 Token 台词，支持人民币/美元、两位小数向上取整及自定义试听；无需在线语音服务或 API Key。代码按 MIT 授权；随包的科比人物图、图标与预制语音不随 MIT 授权再分发，仅限随插件个人非商业使用。需要自己估算费用时，它最多每天一次从 raw.githubusercontent.com（Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter）取公开价格表、从 open.er-api.com 取美元兑人民币汇率，不发送会话数据。
items.descriptionEn: Shows a Kobe iced-tea side popup and reports per-turn costs or token counts with bundled offline audio. The voice switches between four emotion tiers by amount, and the ten most common amounts in both CNY and USD play as whole-sentence takes (400 takes in total). Uses dsh-cost-meter when present, otherwise estimates each request from native usage and public prices, labeled as an estimate. Includes twenty cost phrases, four token phrases, CNY/USD, two-decimal ceiling rounding and custom previews; no runtime TTS service or API key. The code is MIT-licensed; the bundled Kobe portrait, icons and pre-made voice clips are not redistributed under that MIT grant and are for personal, non-commercial use with this plugin only. When it has to estimate a cost itself it fetches a public price table from raw.githubusercontent.com (Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter) and the USD/CNY rate from open.er-api.com, at most once a day, and sends no session data.

items.name: 投稿前检查
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 投稿前核对清单：检查稿件结构与声明（伦理、知情同意、资助、利益冲突、数据可用性等），按关键词核对 CONSORT/STROBE/PRISMA 入门条目并给出定位与建议，扫描投稿包（正文、投稿信、编号图件与缺号、表格、补充材料、声明）并输出 JSON/Markdown 报告；是清单，不是合规裁定。
items.descriptionEn: Pre-submission checklist for DeepSeek Harness: manuscript structure and declaration statements, keyword-based coverage of starter CONSORT / STROBE / PRISMA items with locators and advice, and a submission-pack scan (manuscript, cover letter, numbered figures with gap detection, tables, supplements, declarations) with JSON/Markdown reports; a checklist, not a compliance verdict.

items.name: PII 脱敏
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: PII 脱敏中间件：请求到达模型前把姓名、电话、邮箱、证件、银行卡、密钥与地址匿名化为占位符，展示层还原；还原表只存在内存与受控存储域，不记录明文，提供 /mask 命令与 mask_test 工具。
items.descriptionEn: PII masking middleware for DeepSeek Harness: anonymize names, phones, emails, ID cards, bank cards, keys and addresses to placeholders before requests reach the model, restore them at the display layer, keep the restore table only in memory and a controlled storage domain, never log plaintext, and expose /mask and the mask_test tool.

items.name: MCP 管理器
items.author: wingsky-1
items.description: MCP 服务器管理插件：分工作目录维护项目级 / 全局两级 MCP 配置（项目级随仓库走、可提交 git），模型面经中间层恒定两个原子工具（ws_mcp_search / ws_mcp_call）按会话 cwd 路由、不同仓库互不串台；支持 stdio / streamable-http 双传输、JSON 导入与浮窗状态面板。
items.descriptionEn: MCP server management plugin: per-working-directory project/global config tiers (project-level travels with the repo, committable to git); the model surface stays at two middleware atomic tools (ws_mcp_search / ws_mcp_call) routed by session cwd, so different repos never clash; stdio / streamable-http transports, JSON import and a floating status panel.

items.name: MCP 管理面板
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 官方 MCP 客户端的控制台：/mcp 与设置页 MCP 页签给出只读运行时视图（连接状态、已注册工具、错误与重连计数），并在 cordis.patch.yml 上做走审批、先备份的 server CRUD 与工具试用台。
items.descriptionEn: Console for the official DSH MCP client: a read-only runtime view (connection status, registered tools, errors, reconnect counts) in /mcp and a Settings tab, plus approval-gated, backed-up server CRUD through cordis.patch.yml and a tool trial console.

items.name: mcptoon MCP 接入
items.author: activeing123
items.description: 把 mcptoon 作为一条 stdio MCP 服务接入，让 agent 通过 mcptoon 的压缩视图发现已配置 MCP server 的工具，而非每轮支付完整 JSON schema。附带 doctor CLI：校验 mcptoon 可执行文件能否解析，不能时打印精确的 command/args 覆盖配置。
items.descriptionEn: Mounts the mcptoon MCP bridge as one stdio server, so the agent discovers the tools of every MCP server you have configured through mcptoon's compressed view instead of full JSON schemas on each turn. Ships a doctor CLI that checks the mcptoon executable resolves and prints the exact command/args override when it does not.

items.name: 病案首页质控
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向病案质控的纯本地病案首页核对：依据国卫办医发〔2016〕24号等公开文件，核对首页各字段的齐备性与字段间的逻辑矛盾（如病案号为空），输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么、依据哪条」的清单——只列出缺失或不一致之处供人复核，不评价临床正确性。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only front-sheet (medical record) QC: following 国卫办医发〔2016〕24号 and other published documents, check field completeness and internal logical contradictions between the fields (e.g. a blank record number), and report a line-by-line list of which row, which column, what differs and which clause says so — missing or inconsistent items for human review only; it does not assess clinical correctness.

items.name: 跨会话记忆
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 有界、分层、带审批门、可审计的跨会话记忆：typed ctx.memory 服务、零依赖 SQLite 存储、memory 工具与冻结快照注入。
items.descriptionEn: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: a typed ctx.memory seam, a zero-dependency SQLite provider, a memory tool and frozen snapshot injection.

items.name: 项目记忆 Memoir
items.author: Qinling-Melon-Farmers
items.description: 项目持久化记忆与会话经验沉淀：memoir_record / memoir_read 工具（BM25 相关度排序检索）、每轮工作自动蒸馏、记忆诊断面板与跨项目全局检索，纯本地零外部依赖。
items.descriptionEn: Project persistent memory and session-lessons distillation: memoir_record / memoir_read tools with BM25-ranked retrieval, per-turn auto-distill, a memory diagnostics panel and cross-project search - fully local, no external dependency.

items.name: 项目记忆
items.author: DamonKoy
items.description: 按项目作用域持久化的键值记忆，支持增删查列与搜索。
items.descriptionEn: Project-scoped persistent key-value memories with set/get/list/delete/search.

items.name: 记忆引擎
items.author: jiudouliang
items.description: 本地记忆插件 dsh-memory-engine：聊天时自动记下值得记的事，按遗忘曲线变淡，共享关键词自动连线，图谱可旋转、可点选、可搜索；支持编辑、删除、导出。默认开启会话导入（每 60 分钟最多 200 条，只取用户消息，自动过滤工作指令与重复内容），自动记忆默认关闭。数据只写本机 ~/.dsh/memory-engine 的 JSON 文件，明文、不上传。
items.descriptionEn: dsh-memory-engine is a local memory plugin: it captures facts worth remembering from chat, fades them along a forgetting curve, links them by shared keywords, and renders a rotatable, clickable graph with search, edit, delete and export. Session import is on by default (up to 200 user messages every 60 minutes, with work-instruction and duplicate filtering); automatic memory capture is off by default. Data stays on this machine as plain JSON under ~/.dsh/memory-engine and is never uploaded.

items.name: 元分析计算
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的元分析算术：效应量换算（OR/RR/d/r/SMD，由 CI 求 SE）并注明公式，固定效应与 DerSimonian-Laird 随机效应合并，Q/df/p、I²、τ²、森林图数据，Markdown/SARIF 报告与 k≥10 的轻量 Egger 检验；纯本地、零依赖、可由输入复算。
items.descriptionEn: Meta-analysis arithmetic for DeepSeek Harness: effect-size conversions (OR/RR/d/r/SMD, SE from CI) with named formulas, fixed-effect and DerSimonian–Laird random-effects pooling, Q/df/p, I2, tau2, forest-plot data, Markdown/SARIF reports and a light Egger test at k >= 10; local, dependency-free and reproducible from the inputs.

items.name: 会话里程碑导航条
items.author: SnowCrescenter-tech
items.description: DSH Web UI 右侧的圆点时间轴：每条提问一个圆点，悬停查看内容与元信息（时间、轮次、耗时、TTFT、token），点击即跳转；附带全会话消息列表、站内与跨会话搜索、书签深链接（#msg=）和键盘导航。
items.descriptionEn: Git-style dot timeline on the right edge of the DSH web UI: one dot per user message, hover for content and metadata (time, turn, duration, TTFT, tokens), click to jump; full-session list, in-session and cross-session search, #msg= deep-link bookmarks, keyboard navigation.

items.name: MiMo 多模态工具
items.author: ch1bug
items.description: 把小米 MiMo API 封装为 agent 工具：联网搜索、图像/音频/视频理解、语音转写、语音合成与音色克隆（mimo_search/vision/audio/video/asr/tts/voiceclone）。
items.descriptionEn: Turns the Xiaomi MiMo API into agent tools: web search, image/audio/video understanding, speech-to-text, text-to-speech and voice cloning (mimo_search/vision/audio/video/asr/tts/voiceclone).

items.name: Mnemon 记忆系统
items.author: omdsh-dev
items.description: 与 Mnemon CLI 集成的跨 Agent、本地优先持久记忆插件：用户画像 / 工作记忆 / 项目档案与长期 Memory Spaces，支持导入导出。
items.descriptionEn: A cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin integrating the Mnemon CLI: profiles, working memory, project documents and long-term Memory Spaces, with import and export.

items.name: 多线程下载器
items.author: NONON01
items.description: 在 DSH 内用 HTTP Range 分片并发下载文件：侧边栏面板、对话进度条、断点续传、自定义请求头、镜像回退、SHA-256 校验、限速与 Agent 工具。
items.descriptionEn: Parallel HTTP Range downloads inside DSH with a sidebar panel, composer progress strip, resume, custom headers, mirrors, SHA-256 checks, rate limiting and an agent tool.

items.name: Notebook 复现采集
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Notebook 复现采集：不执行、只读取 .ipynb，报告内核与语言、代码/文本单元、执行顺序（乱序与从未运行）、import、运行时安装、随机种子、绝对路径与输出状态，并对 notebook 与环境声明做哈希，输出 REP 证据、Markdown 采集卡与 SARIF。
items.descriptionEn: Notebook reproducibility capture for DeepSeek Harness: reads .ipynb JSON without executing it, reports kernel/language, code vs markdown cells, execution order (out-of-order and never-run cells), imports, runtime installs, seeds, absolute paths and output state; hashes the notebook and environment declarations; writes REP evidence and a record; renders a Markdown capture card and SARIF.

items.name: dsh-notifier
items.author: wingsky-1
items.description: 审批/完成/错误事件通知：浏览器 Notification + 系统原生 toast（Windows PowerShell WinRT / Linux·macOS notify-send，零依赖）；提示音可配、错误同类合并、免打扰时段、通知历史与配置面板；非安全上下文自动降级横幅。
items.descriptionEn: Approval / completion / error event notifications: browser Notification API plus native OS toasts (Windows PowerShell WinRT, Linux and macOS notify-send, zero dependencies); configurable sound, error merging, quiet hours, notification history and a settings panel; falls back to in-page banners outside secure contexts.

items.name: Notion 集成
items.author: Zhiyi-Zhao
items.description: DSH Notion 技能：通过官方 REST API 读写 Notion 工作区——搜索/读取页面（转 markdown）、创建/更新页面、查询/新增/更新数据库条目；纯 Python 标准库、零依赖、Windows / macOS / Linux 通用。
items.descriptionEn: A DSH Notion skill: read and write your Notion workspace via the official REST API - search/read pages as markdown, create/update pages, query/add/update database entries; pure Python stdlib, zero dependencies, cross-platform.

items.name: 小说摸鱼
items.author: gongfpp
items.description: 面向 DSH Web 0.2.x，兼容区间 >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0（真实页面验收在 0.2.2-alpha.2；0.2.2-rc.1 由只读宿主契约探针跑过 7 项检查）。主动展开选中的原生聊天区域时，在真实内容下方追加本地 EPUB、TXT、Markdown 小说片段；按书保存进度，不将小说发送给模型。无独立阅读页，EPUB 只显示文字。
items.descriptionEn: For DSH Web 0.2.x within the range >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 (real page acceptance ran on 0.2.2-alpha.2; 0.2.2-rc.1 passed the read-only host contract probe with 7 checks). Explicitly expanding selected native chat regions appends local EPUB, TXT and Markdown novel passages below real content. Per-book progress; no novel text sent to the model, no standalone reader, text-only EPUB.

items.name: 国自然形式审查
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向科研管理人员的 DeepSeek Harness 检查插件：读取国自然申请书的正文行与电子文档属性，按本机构名单和版本化规则库核对形式要件、篇幅与匿名化，报出「哪条、哪行、差什么」，每条发现都标出所依据的条款与依据类型。
items.descriptionEn: Check for research administrators in DeepSeek Harness: read the body lines and electronic document properties of an NSFC grant application, and check format requirements, length and anonymization against the host institution's name list and a versioned rule library; each finding names the item, line and difference, with the clause and basis type it relies on.

items.name: 护理记录核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向护理质量管理的纯本地护理记录核对：依据《病历书写基本规范》等公开文件，核对护理记录的书写时限、签名，以及跌倒与压力性损伤等评估表的完整性，把一次住院的护理记录核对成逐条可复核的差异清单——每条都写明所引条款，列出缺失或次序不符之处供人复核。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only nursing-record check for nursing quality management: following 《病历书写基本规范》 and other published documents, verify entry timing, signatures and the completeness of assessment forms such as fall-risk and pressure-ulcer forms, and turn one episode's records into a line-by-line list of reviewable differences — each naming the clause it comes from, with missing or out-of-sequence items flagged for human review.

items.name: 可观测导出
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: OpenTelemetry 与 Langfuse 导出：轮次、步骤、工具与 LLM 跨度，token 与成本指标，脱敏的提示与补全采集，异步批处理与退避重试。
items.descriptionEn: OpenTelemetry and Langfuse exporter: turn, step, tool and LLM spans, token and cost metrics, sanitized prompt and completion capture, async batching and retry with backoff.

items.name: Oh My Claude
items.author: lcestou
items.description: 把已登录的 Claude Code CLI 作为 dsh 的对话模型提供方：每次请求都通过 stream-json 驱动 claude -p，用的是 CLI 自己的登录，无需 API key、无额外服务、无运行时依赖。模型选择器实时列出你的账号可用的 Claude 模型；会话逐个续跑，并能跨 dsh 重启；Claude 的权限请求转为 dsh 审批；dsh 的工具通过 MCP 提供给 Claude；支持图片输入；套餐用量与 CLI 的上下文占用显示在 dsh 的上下文环里；composer 旁的一个按钮打开记忆、指令、技能、回退、改动、MCP、诊断、任务与调校面板；保存一台 SSH 机器后，dsh 的添加工作区对话框可选该机器上的目录，会话里的 Claude 就在远端运行。界面中英双语。需要本机已登录的 Claude Code CLI；支持 dsh 0.2.2-alpha.2 至 0.2.2-rc.1（0.2.0、0.2.1 走 npm 的 dsh-0.2.1 标签，0.1.x 走 dsh-0.1.x 标签）。
items.descriptionEn: Your logged-in Claude Code CLI as a dsh conversation provider: every request drives claude -p over stream-json, so it uses the CLI's own login with no API key, no extra service and no runtime dependency. The model picker lists the Claude models your account can use; sessions resume one by one and survive a dsh restart; Claude's permission prompts become dsh approvals; dsh's tools reach Claude over MCP; images go in; plan usage and the CLI's own context breakdown show in dsh's context ring; one button beside the composer opens the Memory, Instructions, Skills, Rewind, Changes, MCP, Diagnostics, Tasks and Tune panel; once an SSH box is saved, dsh's Add workspace dialog can pick a folder on it and the session's Claude runs there. English and Chinese UI. Needs a logged-in Claude Code CLI on the box; runs on dsh 0.2.2-alpha.2 through 0.2.2-rc.1 (0.2.0 and 0.2.1 via the npm dsh-0.2.1 tag, 0.1.x lines via the dsh-0.1.x tags).

items.name: 原产地区域价值成分台账核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向关务与原产地管理的纯本地原产地判定台账核对：依据各自由贸易协定原产地规则，核对协定与产品是否声明、区域价值成分是否等于 (FOB−非原产材料价值)÷FOB×100 且达到配置门槛、每条料件是否填写原产国与原产地标准、料件序号是否唯一、品名栏是否残留占位符，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——只核台账自身算术与字面差异，不判断能否取得原产资格，原件只读。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only origin-determination register check: following free-trade-agreement origin rules, verify that the agreement and product are declared, that regional value content equals (FOB minus non-originating value) divided by FOB times 100 and meets the configured threshold, that each material states its origin and origin criterion, that material numbers are unique and that no placeholder survives in the description column — a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list; its own arithmetic and literal differences only, no origin-eligibility verdict, the original is read-only.

items.name: OTA 点评回复台账核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向酒店运营与客服的纯本地 OTA 点评回复台账核对：核对每条点评是否记录内容或评分、已回复的点评是否记录回复日期与回复人、回复是否早于点评、未回复的点评是否落在台账自己写明的回复期限之内、问题分类是否取自本机构口径、点评编号是否唯一，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——只列材料内部能逐条指认的差异，不评价回复内容是否恰当，原件只读。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only OTA guest-review reply-register check: verify that each review records its content or score, that a replied review carries a reply date and a responder, that no reply precedes its review, that an unreplied review falls inside the deadline the register itself states, that the issue category comes from the institution's vocabulary and that review numbers are unique — a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list; differences the material itself can be held to only, no judgement on whether a reply is appropriate, the original is read-only.

items.name: 输出风格
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 对标 Claude Code outputStyles：按会话生效、可持久、运行时切换的输出风格，Markdown 风格库、/style 命令与系统提示注入。
items.descriptionEn: Claude Code outputStyles for DSH: session-scoped, durable and runtime-switchable output styles with a Markdown style library, a /style command and system-prompt injection.

items.name: 试卷结构核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向教研与命题管理的纯本地试卷解析结果核对：核对每道题是否填写题号与题干、是否填写答案或解析、各题分值合计是否等于表头试卷总分、题型是否取自配置口径、难度系数是否落在配置范围内、题目标识是否齐备且唯一、是否标注知识点、题干栏是否残留占位符，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——只列材料内部能逐条指认的差异，不改原件，不作出定性结论。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only parsed exam-paper check: verify that each question records its number and stem, that an answer or explanation is present, that item scores total the paper score the header states, that question types come from the configured vocabulary, that the difficulty coefficient falls inside the configured range, that question identifiers are present and unique, that a knowledge point is recorded and that no placeholder survives in the stem — a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list; differences pointable inside the material only, the original is not modified, and no verdict is given.

items.name: 参数映射与修复
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的厂商参数映射与确定性 JSON 修复：在 11 家服务商之间映射 temperature/top_p/max_tokens/stop/system，并按可审计规则修复损坏的 JSON 工具输出。
items.descriptionEn: Vendor parameter mapping and deterministic JSON repair for DeepSeek Harness: map temperature/top_p/max_tokens/stop/system across 11 vendors and repair broken JSON tool output with auditable rules.

items.name: 远程访问网关
items.author: slywalker2006
items.description: 为 DSH Web 公网部署增加登录与多租户控制的网关插件：自动 HTTPS、多账号权限/配额/沙箱、会话级访问控制、登录限流与审计日志、SQLite 静态加密（内置于 dsh web 前端，中英双语 UI）。
items.descriptionEn: Server-grade gateway that turns DeepSeek Harness into a multi-tenant platform: remote access + automatic HTTPS, per-subuser permissions and quotas, sandbox enforcement, first-run setup, SQLite auth with at-rest encryption, rate-limit and audit log (bilingual UI).

items.name: 工资表核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向薪酬、人事与财务的工资表核对：按已公开并带复核日期的社保、公积金与个税参数逐行核对缴费基数、费率、险种与应发实发勾稽，给出差异、依据与金额，结果分 pass / pass_with_gaps / review / fail 四档，不代申报。
items.descriptionEn: Payroll audit for DeepSeek Harness: checks a payroll sheet row by row against published social-insurance, housing-fund and individual-income-tax parameters that carry their own review date, covering contribution bases, rates, insurance types and gross-to-net arithmetic, with differences, sources and amounts in pass / pass_with_gaps / review / fail; no filing on the user's behalf.

items.name: PDF 表格抽取
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的纯本地 PDF 表格抽取：pdf_inspect 检查是否存在文本层，pdf_tables 按坐标还原行列，pdf_to_csv 导出带引号转义、可逐格核对的 CSV；不做 OCR，扫描件不支持。
items.descriptionEn: Pure-local PDF table extraction for DeepSeek Harness: pdf_inspect checks for a text layer, pdf_tables reconstructs rows and columns from coordinates, and pdf_to_csv writes a quote-escaped CSV that can be verified cell by cell; no OCR, scanned PDFs are not supported.

items.name: 权限规则
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: Claude Code 风格的声明式权限规则：按序 allow/deny/ask 的 YAML 规则在 tools/pre-execute 瀑布上匹配工具名、参数与工作区路径，带会话日志审计、干跑与热重载。
items.descriptionEn: Claude Code-style declarative permission rules: ordered allow/deny/ask YAML rules matching tool names, arguments and workspace paths on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, with session-log audit, dry-run mode and hot reload.

items.name: 行政许可办理台账核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向行政许可经办与审批辅助的纯本地许可办理台账核对：依据《中华人民共和国行政许可法》与随包的版本化规则包（PR-001…PR-007），逐行核对申请材料、法定时限与决定记录是否闭环——申请人栏是否填写、受理与决定日期是否可解析且先后成立、时限是否落在法定期限内、决定是否留痕、编号是否唯一，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——只提示差异，不作出定性结论，许可决定留给审批人，原件只读。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only administrative licensing register check: following the PRC Administrative Licensing Law and the versioned rule pack it ships (PR-001..PR-007), verify row by row that the application materials, statutory time limits and decision records close the loop — applicant fields are filled, receipt and decision dates parse and follow one another, the deadline falls inside the statutory limit, the decision is recorded and numbers are unique — and return a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list; differences only, no verdict, the permit decision stays with the approver, the original is read-only.

items.name: 人格续忆 Bot
items.author: shinji00222
items.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的每个人格一份独立的本地 Markdown 跨会话记忆（无需 Git）：支持普通会话直接选人格与新建人格、自动提炼去重、凭据自动脱敏、历史会话一键导入与工作区旧对话召回；数据全本地存储在 $DSH_HOME/persona-continuity/memories/，普通/子会话/无痕会话默认隔离。也支持合并 Tobs Bot 模式（私聊工作过程时间轴、微信直觉多人格群聊、全体工作区授权）。
items.descriptionEn: Per-persona cross-session local Markdown memory (no Git required) for DeepSeek Harness: pick or create personas directly in standard sessions, automatic distillation and deduplication, credential filtering, one-click historical session import, and workspace history recall. All data stays local under $DSH_HOME/persona-continuity/memories/, with standard, sub-session, and incognito sessions isolated by default. Also supports an optional Tobs Bot bundle with DM work-process timeline, multi-persona group chat, and group workspace authorization.

items.name: 宠物额度气泡
items.author: Daizhdd
items.description: 在 DSH 桌面宠物头上显示今日 token 用量：按输入+缓存读+缓存写+输出与侧边栏同口径统计，分轻度/中度/重度三档，档位只用一个彩色圆点表示，无进度条与百分比；另有任务完成、本轮失败、跨档三类事件气泡，全部通过宠物插件公开的 announce 接口推送，不改动任何第三方代码。
items.descriptionEn: Shows today token usage as a bubble above the DSH desktop pet: counts input + cache-read + cache-write + output with the same convention as the sidebar, sorts the day into three tiers shown as a single coloured dot (no progress bar, no percentage), and adds completion / failure / tier-change bubbles through the pet plugin public announce API without patching any third-party code.

items.name: 本机决策层
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地非生成式决策层：phocinae_ask 回答批量的是/否、单选与 2–10 评分，phocinae_gate 与 tools/pre-execute 门把同一判断变成 allow/ask/deny；由本机小型决策模型返回带校准置信度的类型化裁决，服务不可达时转人工而不是静默放行（需在本机 8155 端口运行 phocinae-server）。
items.descriptionEn: Local non-generative decision layer for DeepSeek Harness: phocinae_ask answers batched yes/no, single-choice and 2-10 score questions, while phocinae_gate and a tools/pre-execute gate turn the same judgement into allow/ask/deny; a small local decision model returns typed verdicts with calibrated confidence, and an unreachable service escalates to a human instead of silently allowing (requires phocinae-server on local port 8155).

items.name: 手机收件箱
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的入站手机（微信桥）附件收件箱：列出本会话真正收到的附件，经检查后按需取进工作区并恢复被桥压坏的文件名；不新开通道、不复制多余文件，取用全程留痕。
items.descriptionEn: Inbound phone (WeChat bridge) attachment inbox for DeepSeek Harness: list the attachments a session actually received, adopt one into the workspace on demand after checks, and restore filenames mangled by the bridge; no new channel, no redundant copies, and every adoption is recorded.

items.name: Pilot 浏览器驾驶舱
items.author: guo6x
items.description: 给 agent 一双会开车的手：零依赖 CDP 浏览器操控（8 个 pilot_* 工具：导航/点击/输入/按键/JS/截图）+ Web GUI 可拖拽驾驶舱面板，无需 Playwright、无需 API key。
items.descriptionEn: Give your agent hands: zero-dependency CDP browser control (8 pilot_* tools: navigate/click/type/keys/eval/screenshot) plus a draggable cockpit panel in the Web GUI - no Playwright, no API key.

items.name: 项目全流程文件链条核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向项目经理与内审的纯本地项目全流程文件链条核对：读入项目表头与逐环节文件行，按随包的 8 条规则核对环节先后、文件齐备与金额口径是否自洽——环节顺序、必备文件、金额与合计是否可解析、阶段与日期是否一致，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——只提示差异，不作出定性结论，结论留给审核人，原件只读。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only project document-chain check for project managers and internal audit: read a project header plus one row per stage document and apply the eight versioned rules to verify stage order, document completeness and amount consistency — sequence, mandatory documents, parseable amounts and totals, matching stages and dates — returning a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list; differences only, no verdict, the verdict stays with the reviewer, the original is read-only.

items.name: 起诉状要素核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向诉讼代理与法务的纯本地起诉状要素核对：读入一份起诉状（或申请书）要素核对表，按随包的版本化规则包逐条核对每项诉请是否写明事实依据、是否指明证据与法律依据，写了金额的诉请是否写明金额与履行期限，文书是否写明原告与被告、要素序号是否唯一、是否残留占位符，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么、怎么补」的清单——只提示差异，结论留给复核人，原件只读。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only pleading-element check for litigators and legal teams: read one pleading (or application) element checklist and apply the versioned rule pack row by row to verify that every claim records its factual basis, points at evidence and states its legal basis, that a monetary claim states an amount and a performance deadline, that the document names both parties, that element numbers are unique and that no placeholder survives — returning which row, which column, what differs and how to fix it; it does not decide whether a claim will succeed, whether it is time-barred, whether jurisdiction is right or whether the case should be accepted — differences only, the verdict stays with the reviewer, the original is read-only.

items.name: 插件自动更新
items.author: chendaleiQ
items.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 插件做按包白名单的自动更新：按计划去 npm 查已装插件的最新版本，只更新你勾选的包，本地 link／file 安装、锁定版本和出错的包一律跳过；默认不跨大版本、不装预发布。更新走 profile 里运行中的官方插件管理器，profile 写锁、pnpm 执行、bundle 补丁校验与热重载都由宿主负责，安装失败会把旧版本装回去。每轮结果追加到一份 JSON 日志。
items.descriptionEn: Per-package automatic updates for the DeepSeek Harness plugins you choose: on a schedule it asks npm for the latest version of installed plugins, updates only the packages you tick, and skips local link or file installs, pinned versions and packages with errors. Upgrades stay inside the major version and skip prereleases by default. Updates go through the profile's own running plugin manager, so the profile write lock, the pnpm step, bundle-patch validation and hot reload stay the host's job, and a failed install puts the previous version back. Each cycle is appended to a JSON log.

items.name: 桌面通知与未读角标
items.author: chendaleiQ
items.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加桌面通知与应用图标未读角标：一轮结束、等待审批／回答／计划确认、以及这一轮出错时各弹一条横幅；角标显示有几个会话需要你，看过之后清零，点横幅切到对应会话。文案跟随 DSH 界面语言，子智能体会话默认不提醒，标题与正文长度可配置；宿主还在回环地址上开了一个 HTTP 接口，供脚本和其它工具发通知。
items.descriptionEn: Desktop notifications and an app-icon unread badge for DeepSeek Harness: a banner fires when a turn finishes, when an approval, question or plan confirmation is waiting, and when a turn fails. The badge shows how many sessions need you and clears once viewed, and clicking a banner switches to that session. Copy follows the DSH interface language, subagent sessions stay quiet by default, title and body length are configurable, and a loopback HTTP interface lets scripts and other tools post notifications.

items.name: 插件开发指南
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 把插件开发知识库做成可安装技能：官方文档存档、Cordis 入门、114 个仓的社区档案与实战踩坑。
items.descriptionEn: The plugin-development knowledge base as an installable skill: official docs archive, a Cordis primer, a 114-repository community archive and battle-tested pitfalls.

items.name: 插件门控中心
items.author: Noob-stupid
items.description: DSH 框架升级安全与插件升级门控：升级前契约预检 + 配置备份 + 整树回滚点，失败自动回滚、可一键回上一版，加载不了的插件有确证证据才自动禁用。安装与更新按候选插件的 dsh.engines 与 @deepseek-ai/* 范围门控，非 registry 来源可真装（registry 解析不了时回落 link: 开发式安装）。另带内置多源插件市场作发现层。
items.descriptionEn: Framework-upgrade safety and plugin-version gating for DSH: a contract pre-check, config backup and full-tree rollback point before an upgrade; a failed upgrade auto-rolls back, one click returns to the previous version, and a plugin the new framework cannot load is auto-disabled only on hard evidence. Installs and updates are gated by the candidate's dsh.engines and @deepseek-ai/* ranges; non-registry sources are really installed (falling back to a link: development install when the registry cannot resolve them). Ships a built-in multi-source plugin market as the discovery layer.

items.name: 悬浮重启按钮
items.author: NYSM803
items.description: 在 dsh Web GUI 上加一个可拖动的悬浮重启按钮（仅 Windows 桌面应用）：点击确认后关闭并重新启动应用与 Host，关闭指令发出前可取消、超时会自动收手并说明原因；图标、底色、位置锁定都在设置里改。用 dsh web 起的 CLI 宿主上按钮会显示，但重启必然失败。
items.descriptionEn: A draggable floating restart button for the dsh Web GUI (Windows desktop app only): confirm, then the app and its host close and come back on their own; cancelling works until the close request goes out, and a watchdog ends a restart that never takes effect. Icon, background colour and position lock live in Settings. On a dsh web CLI host the button renders but a restart always fails.

items.name: 插件版本升级
items.author: zuwenyin
items.description: 在插件页新增「版本」标签：一键与多选升级都走插件管理器自己的安装路径，默认就地替换依赖、不卸载插件、启用状态不丢（profile 改不了时才退回先卸载再装，日志写明走的是哪条）；每一步的用时、阶段、原始 pnpm 日志与取消；已发布版本列表（最多列最新 80 个）可一键切换，装不了的版本按你正在跑的 DSH 标出来并禁用；镜像落后于上游时列出缺口；安装源可自己选（官方源 / 大陆镜像 / 私有源，选择写进 profile）。
items.descriptionEn: Adds a Versions tab to the Plugins page: on-demand one-click and multi-select upgrades run through the plugin manager's own install path and replace the dependency in place by default, so the bundle stays loaded and keeps its enabled state (only when the profile manifest cannot be rewritten does it fall back to uninstall-then-install, and the log says which path was taken); per-step elapsed time, phase, the raw pnpm log and cancel; the published version list (newest 80 shown) with one-click switching, where a version the running DSH cannot install is flagged and its button disabled; the versions a configured mirror is missing; and a user-selectable npm registry saved in the profile.

items.name: 政策专报要素核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向政策研究人员与办公室写手的纯本地政策专报要素核对：读入一份专报要素核对表，按逐条引用的版本化规则包（PB-001…PB-008）核对每节是否写明核心观点、观点是否有支撑依据、依据是否注明出处、数据截止日期是否可解析且不在未来、建议事项是否写明实施主体，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——只提示差异，结论留给审核人，原件只读。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only policy-brief element check for policy researchers and drafting offices: read one brief element checklist and apply the versioned, verbatim-citing rule pack (PB-001..PB-008) to verify that each section states its point, that every point has supporting evidence citing a source, that the data cutoff parses and is not in the future, that figures are fresh enough under the configured window, that a recommendation names who implements it, that the brief names its title and recipient and that section numbers are unique — returning a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list; it does not decide whether a point is right, whether the evidence is sufficient or whether a recommendation is feasible — differences only, the verdict stays with the reviewer, the original is read-only.

items.name: 安装体检
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 只读安装体检：从本地 npm tarball 抽取包声明的能力并按固定规则折算 R0–R3 风险，逐条断言 tarball 与快照是否一致，并把安装日志归因到 resolve/fetch/extract/link/build/activate 中的某一阶段、给出根因与下一步动作；不改环境、不执行包内代码。
items.descriptionEn: Read-only install doctor for DeepSeek Harness: extracts declared capabilities from a local npm tarball and derives an R0–R3 risk level, asserts tarball-vs-snapshot consistency, and attributes install-log failures to a stage (resolve/fetch/extract/link/build/activate) with root cause and next actions; no environment changes, no package code execution.

items.name: 接口调试
items.author: lemonmmice
items.description: 类 Postman 接口调试面板：由宿主服务端发起 HTTP 请求（绕过浏览器 CORS），支持 WebSocket / 原始 TCP / gRPC、鉴权助手、环境变量、cURL 导入导出、请求集合与历史。
items.descriptionEn: Postman-style API debug panel: host-side HTTP requests without browser CORS limits, plus WebSocket / raw TCP / gRPC, auth helpers, env variables, cURL import/export, request collections and history.

items.name: 线损电量拆分核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向供电所与线损管理岗的纯本地线损电量拆分核对：读取供电量、售电量、线损电量、线损率与计量点清单，按公开的线损计算口径（DL/T 686-2018、GB/T 8170-2008）核对供电量与售电量之差是否等于线损电量、线损率是否按口径计算、数值修约是否合规，输出「哪一行、差多少、该改什么」的清单——只提示差异，原件只读。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only line-loss split check for utility stations and line-loss teams: read supplied energy, sold energy, declared line-loss energy and rate plus the metering-point list and run arithmetic and interval checks under the public calculation basis (DL/T 686-2018, GB/T 8170-2008) — every finding carries its formula and tolerance, verifying that supplied minus sold equals line-loss energy, that the rate follows the basis and that rounding conforms; checks that cannot run land in `skipped` with a reason — returning which row does not close, by how much, and what to fix; differences only, no verdict, the original is read-only.

items.name: 电源菜单（macOS）
items.author: DDDMUC
items.description: 给 DSH 桌面版（macOS）加一个右上角电源按钮：关闭 DSH / 重启 DSH。重启会把窗口拉回来，并确认新进程真的注册到窗口服务器。接口注册在宿主自带的 web 服务器上，只在本机回环地址上应答；启用后会往会话注入一段全局提示，说明这几个按钮怎么用。仅支持 macOS。
items.descriptionEn: Adds a top-right power button to the DSH desktop app on macOS: Shut Down / Restart. Restart brings the window back and verifies the new process registered with the window server. Its routes live on the host's own web server and answer only on the loopback address, and enabling the plugin injects a short global prompt explaining the buttons. macOS only.

items.name: 电力工作票核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向电力运维的纯本地工作票核对：依据现行电力安全工作规程，核对工作票应载明的要素、五项安全技术措施，以及签发、许可与终结的先后顺序，输出「哪一栏、差什么、怎么补」的清单——只报告发现的差异，不判定作业是否安全、许可是否有效，结论留给审核人。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only electrical work-ticket check for power operations: following current electrical safety regulations, verify the required ticket elements, the five safety measures, and the issue → permit → finish sequence, and report which column is short, what is missing and how to fix it — differences only; it does not judge whether the work was safe or the permit validly authorised, the verdict stays with the reviewer.

items.name: PPAP 要素核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向供应商质量/质量工程师的 DeepSeek Harness 数据型核对插件：读取一份 PPAP 提交要素清单（零件表头加每个要素一行），按随包的版本化规则包 PP-001..PP-007 逐条核对提交等级与要素齐备/自洽，只列材料内部能指认的差异，不判合规、不认定责任。
items.descriptionEn: Data-oriented PPAP check for DeepSeek Harness aimed at supplier quality engineers: read a PPAP submission-element checklist (part header plus one row per element), apply the bundled versioned rule pack PP-001..PP-007 to check submission level and element completeness and consistency, and list only the differences the material itself can identify; it does not judge compliance or assign responsibility.

items.name: 插件开发入门
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: DSH 插件开发知识库：官方文档逐字镜像、版本兼容矩阵、迁移 seam 与实战踩坑，装成按需加载的 agent 技能，另附 `dsh-plugin-dev new / check / verify` 脚手架与检查 CLI。
items.descriptionEn: DSH plugin development knowledge base: a verbatim mirror of the official docs, version-compatibility matrix, migration seams and field notes, installed as an on-demand agent skill, plus the `dsh-plugin-dev new / check / verify` scaffolding and check CLI.

items.name: 进度款审核
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的纯本地进度款审核：读申报 CSV 与可选合同基准 CSV，逐项核对量与单价，用整数分算出本期金额、累计金额与累计比例，列出超量 / 单价 / 重复项并导出审核底稿 CSV——不联网、不调用模型、不上传。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only progress-payment audit for DeepSeek Harness: read a declaration CSV plus an optional contract-baseline CSV, check quantity and unit price line by line, compute the period amount, cumulative amount and cumulative ratio in integer cents, list over-quantity / price / duplicate issues, and export a review worksheet CSV — no network, no model call, no upload.

items.name: 质疑与投诉期限核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向政府采购经办与监督人员的纯本地质疑与投诉台账核对：依据《政府采购质疑和投诉办法》（财政部令第94号）与随包规则包（PD-001…PD-007），逐行核对关键日期是否记录、先后关系是否成立、答复是否落在台账写明的期限内、处理状态是否取自配置口径、质疑函编号是否唯一，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——只提示差异，原件只读。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only query-and-complaint register check for procurement staff and supervisors: following the Government Procurement Query and Complaint Measures (MOF Order No. 94) and the versioned rule pack it ships (PD-001..PD-007), verify row by row that key dates are recorded, that they parse and follow one another, that a reply falls inside the deadline the register itself states, that statuses come from the configured vocabulary and that query numbers are unique — returning a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list; it does not decide whether a query was filed in time or whether it should be accepted or rejected — differences only, the verdict stays with the reviewer, the original is read-only.

items.name: 厂商参数映射
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的只读参数工具包：params_map / params_compare / params_vendors 把 temperature、top_p、max_tokens、stop、system 等字段在 11 家模型厂商间互相映射，json_repair 按固定规则修好尾逗号、裸换行与截断的 JSON；不联网、不写文件、不调用模型，每一步留可审计记录。
items.descriptionEn: Read-only parameter toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: params_map / params_compare / params_vendors map temperature, top_p, max_tokens, stop, system and related fields across 11 LLM vendors, while json_repair fixes trailing commas, raw newlines and truncated JSON with fixed rules; no network, no file writes, no model calls, and every step leaves an auditable record.

items.name: 用量统计悬浮框
items.author: wingsky-1
items.description: 多 provider 通用用量统计框架：内置 DeepSeek 官方（余额 + 峰谷倒计时徽标 + 每日用量推算）与 OpenCode Go 开箱即用，自写一个 mjs 适配器文件即可接入任意数据源并在设置页热插拔；渲染在宿主端完成，密钥不进浏览器。
items.descriptionEn: A generic multi-provider usage statistics framework: DeepSeek official (balance + peak/valley countdown badge + daily usage estimation) and OpenCode Go adapters built in out of the box; plug in any data source with one mjs adapter file, hot-swappable from the settings page. Rendering happens host-side - keys never reach the browser.

items.name: 质量事件与 CAPA
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地质量事件插件：读固定表头的 CSV 台账，对 NCR 不良记录去重入库、解析批次别名、评估库存与在途影响，再按 D1–D8 与 CAPA 状态开单推进；全程不联网、不调用模型。
items.descriptionEn: Local quality-event plugin for DeepSeek Harness: read fixed-header CSV ledgers, deduplicate NCR records into the store, resolve batch aliases, assess inventory and in-transit impact, then open and track CAPA or 8D cases by D1-D8 and CAPA status; fully offline with no model calls.

items.name: 侧边快速提问
items.author: Volta-ln
items.description: 在 DSH Web 聊天界面右侧的悬浮面板中，就当前话题提出小问题，由独立轻量会话通过官方 /api RPC 回答，不写入、不影响主对话。支持流式正文、可折叠思考、工具 chips、停止按钮、agent 预设选择，并自动抓取主对话最近内容作为背景。
items.descriptionEn: A floating side panel on the right edge of the DSH Web chat view that answers small questions about the current topic in an independent lightweight session driven through the official /api RPC, leaving the main conversation untouched. Streaming text, collapsible reasoning, tool chips, stop button, agent-preset selector, and an automatic context snapshot from the visible main chat.

items.name: 铁路施工天窗台账核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向铁路施工调度与现场管理的纯本地施工天窗台账核对：读取当日表头与每条天窗一行，按随包的 7 条规则核对时间窗、时长算术与命令号是否自洽——计划起止与封锁起止是否可解析且先后成立、时长是否等于起止之差、命令号是否唯一、天窗是否跨越零点，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——不判定施工是否安全、是否应当批准；只提示差异，结论留给审核人，跑不起来的检查进 skipped 并写明原因，原件只读。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only railway work-window register check for dispatchers and site managers: read the day's header plus one row per work window and apply the seven versioned rules to verify time windows, duration arithmetic and order numbers — planned and possession start/end parse and follow one another, duration equals the difference, order numbers are unique, midnight crossings are handled — returning a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list; it does not decide whether the work is safe or should be approved — differences only, the verdict stays with the reviewer, checks that cannot run land in `skipped` with a reason, the original is read-only.

items.name: 维修工单核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 核对一份机动车维修工单：项目金额、配件与工时合计、结算总额是否算术自洽；7 条规则各带条款出处，只列差异、不下结论、不改原件。
items.descriptionEn: Checks a vehicle repair order for arithmetic consistency of item amounts, parts/labour subtotals and grand total; differences only.

items.name: 复现审计
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的复现审计：有界只读扫描记录 git 提交与脏状态、依赖锁、环境固定、输入数据哈希、图表、notebook、随机种子与可运行命令，推导缺口等级与 reproducible/partial/not_reproducible 结论，对比记录清单发现漂移，输出报告卡、Markdown 与 SARIF。
items.descriptionEn: Reproducibility evidence for DeepSeek Harness: a bounded read-only scan records the git commit and dirty state, dependency lockfiles, environment pins, input-data hashes, figures, notebooks, explicit seeds and runnable commands, derives gap severities and a reproducible/partial/not_reproducible level, compares a recorded manifest against the current tree for drift, and renders a report card with Markdown and SARIF.

items.name: 研究证据协议
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: DeepSeek Harness 科研插件家族的共享证据层 REP v1：为源、快照、锚点、证据、论断、检查与产物定义 JSON Schema 与 TypeScript 类型，并提供零依赖的内容寻址证据库、规范化 SHA-256 哈希、SARIF 导出与独立校验 CLI，任何科研插件产出的证据都可离线复算。
items.descriptionEn: REP v1 — the shared Research Evidence Protocol under the DeepSeek Harness research-plugin family: JSON Schema and TypeScript types for sources, snapshots, anchors, evidence, claims, checks, artifacts, audit events and report manifests, plus a zero-dependency content-addressed evidence store, canonical SHA-256 hashing, SARIF export and an independent verifier CLI — one protocol, one store, one verifier, so any research plugin's evidence can be recomputed offline.

items.name: 研究报告
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 可核查的研究报告引擎：内容寻址的证据台账（结论与快照绑定、可发现篡改），版本化封存报告让每条结论带核查结论、manifest 哈希封存整个目录，检索编排复用 ctx.web 与 ctx.jobs 接口。
items.descriptionEn: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness with a content-addressed evidence ledger (claim-snapshot binding, tamper-evident), versioned sealed reports in which every claim carries a verification verdict with the manifest hash sealing the directory, and retrieval orchestration over the ctx.web and ctx.jobs seams.

items.name: 科研 SOP 技能包
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的七个科研 SOP 技能：文献综述、引用审计、主张/证据审计、投稿前检查、审稿回复、可复现审计与数据管理计划；每个技能以 REP 记录或明确结论收尾，不只给散文式建议。
items.descriptionEn: Seven research SOP skills for DeepSeek Harness: literature review, citation audit, claim/evidence audit, manuscript preflight, reviewer response, reproducibility audit and data-management planning; each skill ends in a REP record or an explicit verdict, never in prose alone.

items.name: 审稿回复信核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的审稿回复信工作流：解析 Reviewer/Referee/审稿人 标题行与编号标记（含段落回退），为每条意见分配全局编号与字符位置，按回复编号核对逐条答复（缺失、少于 20 字符、多余、重复），导出带覆盖表的 Markdown 回复信，解析结果与覆盖计数作为 REP 证据——只核对编号与覆盖，不改写审稿意见。
items.descriptionEn: Reviewer-response workflow for DeepSeek Harness: parse reviewer comments (Reviewer/Referee/审稿人 headers and numbered markers, with a paragraph fallback), assign each comment a global number and locator, check point-by-point coverage by response number (missing, under 20 characters, extra, duplicates), and export a Markdown response letter with a coverage table; parsed reviews become REP evidence — coverage checking only, comments are not rewritten.

items.name: 撤稿与更正监测
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的撤稿与更正监测：读取 Crossref 作品记录并用 filter=updates 查询，为每个 DOI 给出 retracted/concern/corrected/notice/clear/unknown 状态，维护带变更检测的只追加时间线，输出 REP v1 证据快照与 SARIF；clear 只表示未登记通告，不代表论文有效。
items.descriptionEn: Retraction and correction monitoring for DeepSeek Harness: reads Crossref work records plus the verified filter=updates query, assigns each DOI a retracted/concern/corrected/notice/clear/unknown status, keeps an append-only timeline with change detection, and emits REP v1 evidence snapshots and SARIF; clear means no registered notice, never proof of validity.

items.name: 审稿意见回应核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向期刊编辑的纯主机端审稿意见回应核对：读取一份审稿意见逐条回应表，按版本化规则库核对意见与回应是否一一对应、回应是否留痕、修改位置是否指明，输出带 locator 的「哪一条、哪一栏、差什么」清单——无法执行的检查写进 skipped 并写明原因，绝不静默通过；不判断回应是否充分、修改是否到位或稿件是否应当录用；只提示差异，不联网、不调用模型，原件只读。
items.descriptionEn: Pure host-side review-comment response check for journal editors: read one comment-by-comment response table and apply the versioned rule pack to verify that every comment has a matching response, that responses leave a paper trail and that the changed location is named — returning locator-carrying findings; checks that cannot run are written into `skipped` with a reason and never pass silently; it does not decide whether a response is adequate, whether the revision is sufficient or whether the manuscript should be accepted — differences only, no network, no model call, the original is read-only.

items.name: 询价比价
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的询价比价：把多家供应商对同一批物料的报价压进一张表，标出谁最低、价差与交期，以及低于成本线、超预算或已过期的报价，金额全程整数分、异常只标记不淘汰，导出可复核 CSV——不联网、不上传报价。
items.descriptionEn: RFQ comparison for DeepSeek Harness: consolidate several suppliers' quotes for the same materials into one table showing who is cheapest, the price spread and lead times, plus quotes below the cost line, over budget or already expired; amounts stay in integer cents, anomalies are flagged rather than disqualified, and a reviewable CSV is exported — no network, no quote upload.

items.name: 规则库文件自检核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 规则库自身核对：读取库头加每条规则一行的规则库（JSON/YAML），按本插件家族自定的条款引用纪律检查规则编号是否唯一、两个依据字段是否至少填一个、摘录是否有实质长度、来源是否写成 http(s) 链接、推论或配置类规则是否带定级、检查类型是否受引擎支持、库头是否声明名称与适用插件版本；只列「哪一条、哪一栏、差什么」，不判合规、不改原件。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only self-check for rule-pack maintainers: applying this plugin family's own citation discipline and severity ceilings (self-imposed, not a national standard), verify line by line that rule ids are unique, basis fields are complete, excerpt length matches the source text, sources are link-shaped, severity does not exceed the ceiling and citations parse — returning which rule, which field, what is inconsistent and what to fix; no compliance verdict, no liability finding and no edit to the original — differences only, the verdict stays with the maintainer.

items.name: RunningHub 工作流
items.author: achenjins
items.description: 调用你在 RunningHub 上保存的 ComfyUI 工作流生成图片、视频和音频。提供 runninghub_search（列出可用操作）与 runninghub_call（执行操作）两个模型工具：把工作流链接或 ID 发给 AI 即可辅助配置输入节点，也可在「插件」→「dsh-runninghub-plugin」配置面板中手动导入和编辑；任务可在后台运行，完成后通知并把结果带回对话。支持多个 RunningHub API Key 按国内站 / 海外站分池管理，余额不足时换用下一把 Key，可查询账户余额与排队情况，并内置可按工作流读写的提示词规范文档。需要自备 RunningHub API Key，运行工作流会消耗账户的 RH 币。
items.descriptionEn: Runs the ComfyUI workflows you saved on RunningHub to generate images, video and audio. Two model tools, runninghub_search (lists the available actions) and runninghub_call (runs one), let the AI configure a workflow's input nodes from its link or ID; workflows can also be imported and edited by hand in the Plugins -> dsh-runninghub-plugin settings panel. Tasks can run in the background and report back with the results when they finish. Multiple RunningHub API keys are pooled separately for the China and international sites, a key that runs out of balance hands over to the next one, account balance and queue can be queried, and per-workflow prompt guideline docs can be read and edited. Requires your own RunningHub API key; running a workflow spends RH coins from that account.

items.name: 安全技术交底记录核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向建筑施工安全管理的纯本地安全技术交底记录核对：依据《建筑施工安全技术统一规范》《建设工程安全生产管理条例》（GB 50870-2013、JGJ 59-2011）与随包规则包（SB-001…SB-007），读取交底记录，逐条核对要素是否齐备、签字是否闭环、签字名单是否对应、工种是否在列、日期是否可解析，输出「哪一条、哪一栏、差什么、怎么补」的清单——只提示差异，原件只读。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only safety technical briefing check for construction safety managers: following GB 50870-2013, JGJ 59-2011 and the versioned rule pack it ships (SB-001..SB-007), read one briefing record (header, recipient and signer lists, trade list) and verify that required elements are present, signatures close the loop, the recipient and signer lists correspond, trades are listed and dates parse — returning which rule, which column, what differs and how to fix it; it does not judge whether the briefing content was adequate or whether a signature is genuine — differences only, the verdict stays with the reviewer, the original is read-only.

items.name: 安全资格台账核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 核对施工安全资格台账：三级教育与学时、培训档案四要素、特种作业证书与有效期、工种匹配及六个月实习期。
items.descriptionEn: Checks a site safety-qualification ledger for training hours, the four required record elements, and special-operation certificate validity against the dates the person worked.

items.name: 插件评分
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 插件多维质量评分：安装成功率、维护活跃度、文档完整度、安全扫描与协议合规，每条结论都有真实 CLI 证据支撑。
items.descriptionEn: Multi-dimensional quality scoring for plugins: install success, maintenance activity, documentation completeness, security scan and protocol compliance, each conclusion backed by real CLI evidence.

items.name: 录屏与截图
items.author: Link-h1j
items.description: 把「说不清」的界面问题变成能直接发给模型的视频 / 图片证据，减少人机沟通的来回损耗：在输入框工具条的「听写」左边加「录屏」「截图」两个按钮。截图：弹出选区浮层（拖动框选 / 单击整屏 / Enter 确认 / Esc 取消），选中的画面直接进附件，拖完框选手一松就能用画笔 / 矩形 / 箭头 / 文字标注，只在选区内生效。录屏：点一下先选「录哪一个」（整个桌面 / 某台显示器 / 某个窗口——跟着窗口移动改大小 / 自定义区域拖框，都带缩略图），再点一下结束（Esc 亦可），产出一个 .webm 视频并自动进附件；抽帧交给会话里的 agent 做。抓屏在宿主进程完成 —— 桌面壳禁用了 getDisplayMedia，浏览器端拿不到流。录屏需要本机 Python 3 + Pillow 与一个带 libvpx 的 ffmpeg（起录前会做能力预检，缺什么会直接说清怎么补，可用 DSH_CAPTURE_PYTHON / DSH_CAPTURE_FFMPEG 指定路径）；截图只需要 PowerShell。仅支持 Windows。
items.descriptionEn: Turns a hard-to-describe UI problem into footage the model can actually look at, cutting the back-and-forth of human-agent communication: adds Record and Capture buttons to the composer toolbar, left of the dictation button. Capture opens a region overlay (drag to select, click for full screen, Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel) and attaches the selection to the message; the annotation toolbar (pen / rectangle / arrow / text) shows up the moment you release the drag and only paints inside the selection. Record first asks what to record (whole desktop / a monitor / a window that is followed as it moves or resizes / a custom region, each with a thumbnail), then stops on a second click (Esc also stops) and produces a single .webm attached to the message; frame extraction is left to the agent in the session. Screen grabbing runs in the host process because the desktop shell disables getDisplayMedia, so the renderer can never obtain a stream. Recording needs a local Python 3 with Pillow plus an ffmpeg built with libvpx; both are probed before recording starts and the error names exactly what to install, and DSH_CAPTURE_PYTHON / DSH_CAPTURE_FFMPEG can point at them explicitly. Capture needs only PowerShell. Windows only.

items.name: 插件安全技能包与门禁
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件供应链安全技能包与安装前门禁：八个中英双语审计技能讲解方法论，plugin_vet 工具执行许可证、SBOM、commit 锁定、恶意模式与数据责任检查，并给出五维加权风险卡（PASS / WARN / FAIL）与 warn|deny 策略。
items.descriptionEn: Plugin supply-chain security skill pack and pre-install gate for DeepSeek Harness: eight bilingual agent skills teach the audit methodology, and the plugin_vet tool runs the license, SBOM, commit-pinning, malicious-pattern and data-responsibility checks, producing a five-dimension weighted risk card (PASS / WARN / FAIL) and a warn|deny policy.

items.name: 会话背景色
items.author: muutot
items.description: 给左侧会话列表的单条会话换背景色：会话行右键 → 选 9 个预设色（色块随深浅色主题适配）或「自定义颜色…」（原生取色器 + 实时预览），颜色按会话持久保存（宿主 JSON 存储，不进模型上下文）。需 DSH 0.2.2+（官方 contextMenus 菜单）；0.2.1-rc.5 请安装旧版 0.2.1。
items.descriptionEn: Color individual conversations in the sidebar: right-click a session row to pick from 9 preset colors (swatches adapt to light/dark theme) or a custom color via a native picker with live preview; persisted per session in a host-side JSON store (never enters model context). Requires DSH 0.2.2+ (official contextMenus); on 0.2.1-rc.5 install the older 0.2.1 release.

items.name: 会话增强（dsh-session-enhance）
items.author: Tinger-X
items.description: 会话管理增强插件：支持真实物理删除、跨工作区分组拖拽搬移会话、一键物理文件与 storages JSON 对账及墓碑防复活机制。
items.descriptionEn: Enhanced session management plugin: physical transcript deletion, cross-workspace drag-and-drop migration, physical file reconciliation, and tombstone anti-resurrection.

items.name: 会话历史
items.author: youxia
items.description: 把 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Pi、DSH、OpenCode、LobsterAI 以及实验性的 WorkBuddy 的对话整理成按天存放的原文 Markdown 日志，并建本地全文索引；以一个共用技能提供给这些 agent，让它们能查到彼此聊过什么。保留原话，不做摘要，不用向量，不调用模型；数据在 ~/.session-history。
items.descriptionEn: Turns conversations from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Pi, DSH, OpenCode, LobsterAI and experimental WorkBuddy into per-day verbatim Markdown logs with a local full-text index, then shares one skill so any of those agents can look up what was said in the others. Original wording is kept: no summaries, no embeddings, no model calls. Data stays in ~/.session-history.

items.name: 会话 ID
items.author: yufengnigel
items.description: 侧边栏底部会话 ID 面板：列出全部会话的完整 ID 并一键复制（纯浏览器、只读，不修改会话状态）。
items.descriptionEn: Sidebar-foot Session ID panel: lists every session with its full id and one-click copy (browser-only and read-only, never mutates sessions).

items.name: 会话复盘
items.author: GreenLv
items.description: 回头看看你是怎么使用 AI 的：/session-insights 会整理一段时间内的 DSH 会话，找出哪些做法有效、哪些问题总在重复、最终真正留下了哪些成果，并生成一份保存在本机的复盘报告。
items.descriptionEn: See how you have been using AI: /session-insights reviews your DSH sessions over time, shows what worked, which problems kept coming back, and what results were actually produced, then creates a retrospective report on your machine.

items.name: 会话同步
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 跨设备会话同步：用一个专用 git 镜像在多台机器之间同步 DeepSeek Harness 的会话与设置，冲突按 append-only 保留双方（分叉文件、不静默覆盖），提供 /sync 命令与 sync_* 工具。
items.descriptionEn: Cross-device session sync for DeepSeek Harness: a dedicated git mirror syncs sessions and settings between machines with append-only keep-both conflict resolution (fork files, never silently overwritten), plus a /sync command and sync_* tools.

items.name: 结算资料核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的纯本地结算资料齐套核对：读资料清单 CSV 与实际提交清单 CSV 逐项对齐，算出齐套率并列出缺件、份数不足、未签字/未盖章与非必需缺失，导出 Excel 可直接打开的核对表——只读文件名、份数与签章标记，不读内容、不联网。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only settlement-document completeness check for DeepSeek Harness: align a checklist CSV with the actual-submission CSV item by item, compute the completeness rate and list missing documents, short copies, missing signatures/stamps and absent optional items, then export an Excel-friendly worksheet — file names, copy counts and stamp markers only, no file contents read, no network.

items.name: 公开用户名核查
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 基于固定 481 站点 Sherlock 清单检查公开用户名，返回六态结果，对 claimed 做随机负样本校验；默认 core 41，all 单次最多 120，NSFW 默认关闭。
items.descriptionEn: Public-username checks over a pinned 481-site Sherlock manifest; six states, random negative-sample verification for claimed results, default core 41, all capped at 120, NSFW off by default.

items.name: 侧栏布局套件
items.author: YONAN1269
items.description: 给 DSH 左侧栏加一条控制栏：把「工作区」和「会话」两组排成标签页或浮层，也可以切回完全不改动布局的官方默认；会话列表默认全部展开。同时管理临时会话——默认在退出 DSH 时删除，可在插件详情页改成每天定时清理，右键可以把单个临时会话保留为正式会话或立即删除。9 项配置在详情页都有图形开关，改配置文件约 3 秒生效、不用重启。
items.descriptionEn: Adds one control bar to the DSH left sidebar: arrange the workspaces and sessions groups as tabs or as an overlay, or switch back to an official default layout that changes nothing; the session list stays fully expanded by default. Also manages temporary sessions — deleted when DSH quits by default, optionally swept on a daily schedule from the plugin detail page, and a right-click menu keeps one as a regular session or deletes it at once. All nine config keys have graphical switches, and config file edits apply in about three seconds without a restart.

items.name: 监理日志核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向工程监理的纯本地监理日志核对：依据 GB/T 50319-2013 等公开文件，核对监理日志的跨日连续性（缺日、同日重复）与旁站监理的覆盖情况，把缺日、重复与漏项逐条指到具体日期、具体栏目与所引条款——只报告缺漏与覆盖差异供人复核。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only supervision-log check for construction supervision: following GB/T 50319-2013 and other published documents, verify cross-day continuity (missing days, duplicate logs on one day) and on-site supervision coverage, pointing every missing day, duplicate and uncovered record at the exact date, column and cited clause — gaps and coverage differences only, for human review.

items.name: 六层记忆底座
items.author: z9134
items.description: 会先审后记、还带审计链的本地记忆：每一轮按你的输入自动召回，写入先过闸门进待审，凭证级内容永不外显，全部动作留哈希链。零外部依赖，数据不出本机；点关系图上的圆点就能看这一条记忆的全部。
items.descriptionEn: Local, auditable long-term memory: query-aware recall every turn, untrusted writes held for review, credential-level content never surfaced, and every action on a hash-chain. Zero runtime dependencies; click a node in the graph to read the whole record.

items.name: 技能中心（Skill Explorer）
items.author: wingsky-1
items.description: DSH 技能中心：按来源分级浏览已加载 skill（系统内置 / 项目 / 用户 / 自定义 / 运行时），支持启用/禁用、创建与删除（移入 .trash）。
items.descriptionEn: DSH skill center: browse loaded skills grouped by source (bundled / project / user / custom / runtime), with enable/disable, create and delete (move to .trash).

items.name: 技能模糊搜索
items.author: ch1bug
items.description: Codex 风格模糊技能搜索：/bug、/diag、/regression 都能在 / 技能菜单里命中 diagnosing-bugs（名称子序列 + 描述连续子串匹配）。
items.descriptionEn: Codex-style fuzzy skill search: /bug, /diag and /regression all find diagnosing-bugs in the / skill menu (name subsequence + description substring matching).

items.name: 技能安装
items.author: Joey-K-tsubame
items.description: 从 GitHub 仓库搜索并安装 SKILL.md 技能：装到全局 / 当前项目 / 自定义目录，与内置 skill-filesystem 联动，装完即时生效；安装会把第三方仓库的 SKILL.md 原样写入技能根目录，只装信任的仓库。
items.descriptionEn: Search GitHub repositories and install their SKILL.md skills into the global, project, or a custom directory; hot-loads through the built-in skill-filesystem; installation copies a third-party repository's SKILL.md verbatim into a skills root — only install repositories you trust.

items.name: Skills 管理器
items.author: hxlog
items.description: 在 DSH 设置中从 Git 仓库导入 Agent Skills，按仓库分组管理，逐项启用或停用，展开查看 SKILL.md 正文；停用的技能不会注册进模型，仓库以只读快照保存。
items.descriptionEn: Import Agent Skills from Git repositories into DSH settings, group them by repository, toggle each skill, and expand SKILL.md content; disabled skills are not registered with the model and repositories are kept as read-only snapshots.

items.name: 三重一大决策台账核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向国企与事业单位办公室、纪检的纯本地「三重一大」决策台账核对：依据中办发〔2010〕17号意见与版本化规则库，读取企业表头与每个议题一行，逐条核对前置研究、会议审议与决议记录的程序留痕是否齐备、议题类别是否取自取值口径、会议与决议日期是否可解析且先后成立、表决与回避是否记录，输出带行号与栏位的差异清单——只提示差异，原件只读。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only “three-important-and-one-large” decision register check for SOE and public-institution governance, compliance and discipline staff: following the 2010 CPC General Office opinion and a versioned rule pack, read the enterprise header plus one row per matter and verify that the procedural trail — preliminary study, meeting deliberation and resolution record — is complete, that categories come from the allowed vocabulary, that meeting and resolution dates parse and follow one another, and that voting and recusal fields are recorded — returning findings with a locator (row, column), `found`, `expected` and `fix`; it never fills in or guesses what the register does not state — differences only, no compliance verdict, the original is read-only.

items.name: 土壤与地下水监测台账核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向环保调查与监测机构的纯本地土壤与地下水监测台账核对：依据《建设用地土壤污染状况调查技术导则》《地下水环境监测技术规范》与随包规则包（SW-001…SW-008），逐条核对点位信息、监测项目、限值与超标判定、检出限与单位是否齐备且算术自洽，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——只提示差异，原件只读。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only soil and groundwater monitoring register check for environmental investigation and monitoring teams: following the technical guidelines for soil contamination investigation and groundwater monitoring plus the versioned rule pack it ships (SW-001..SW-008), read one monitoring register (project header plus one row per point and parameter) and verify that point data, parameters, limits and exceedance calls, detection limits and units are complete and arithmetically consistent — returning a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list; it does not decide whether contamination exists or whether controls are required — differences only, no verdict, the original is read-only.

items.name: 作业规程同步核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向工艺、质量与文件管理人员的纯本地作业规程同步核对：交一份作业规程台账，按版本化规则库与它引用的 PFMEA、控制计划做机械比对（IATF 16949／汽车行业核心工具手册），核对编号与版本是否一致、控制特性是否对应、工序与文件版本是否同步、引用是否可解析，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——不改原件，不判合规、不认定责任，只提示差异，结论留给审核人。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only works-instruction sync check for process, quality and document-control staff: hand it one works-instruction register and compare it mechanically against the PFMEA and control plan it cites under a versioned rule pack (IATF 16949 / automotive core tools) — verifying that ids and versions match, control characteristics correspond, operations and document revisions stay in sync and citations resolve — returning which row, which column and what differs; it never edits the original and issues no compliance or liability verdict — differences only, the verdict stays with the reviewer.

items.name: 中文文献记录
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的中文文献记录工具（不抓取 CNKI）：读取 RIS/EndNote 风格或「题名：/作者：/来源：」标注文本导出，分配稳定记录 id，按 GB/T 7714-2015（顺序编码制）或 APA 7 排版引用，并做结构性元数据校验（缺字段、年份离谱、DOI 格式错误、重复）——不登录、不绕过访问控制，缺字段只报缺失、绝不臆造。
items.descriptionEn: Chinese-literature tooling for DeepSeek Harness without scraping CNKI: import RIS/EndNote-style or labeled (题名：/作者：/来源：) exports into stable records, format GB/T 7714-2015 (顺序编码制) or APA 7 citations, and run structural metadata validation (missing fields, implausible year, malformed DOI, duplicates) — no login, no access-control bypass; missing fields are reported, never invented.

items.name: SPC 控制图核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 按现行 GB/T 17989.2—2020 控制图常数表核对 SPC 控制图台账：控制限、中心线、Cp/Cpk 的算术与常数表自洽性，只列差异，不判过程是否受控。
items.descriptionEn: SPC control-chart and Cpk check against the current GB/T 17989.2-2020 control-chart constants: checks a control-chart register for control limits, centre line and Cp/Cpk arithmetic and constant-table self-consistency, lists differences only and does not judge whether the process is in control.

items.name: 系统综述台账
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的系统综述台账：记录 PRISMA 2020 方案修订、导入记录（按 DOI/PMID/arXiv/标题去重）、带评审人与阶段的双人筛选、冲突裁决与 RoB 2/ROBINS-I/GRADE 评估，从只追加的决策账本推导 PRISMA 计数并列出完整性问题，导出 prisma.json/md、证据表与台账——任何事项不被静默消解，账本带哈希链可审计。
items.descriptionEn: Systematic-review ledger for DeepSeek Harness: record PRISMA 2020 protocol revisions, imported records (deduplicated by DOI/PMID/arXiv/title), dual screening with reviewer and stage, conflict adjudications and RoB 2 / ROBINS-I / GRADE assessments; derive PRISMA counts with integrity issues from an append-only decision journal and export prisma.json/md, an evidence table and a ledger JSON — nothing is silently resolved, and the hash-chained journal is audit-verifiable.

items.name: 统计数值复核
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的稿件统计复核：解析 APA 风格的 t/F/χ²/r/z 报告值，用零依赖分布重算双侧与上尾 p 值，核对 CI 与 p 是否自洽，给出精确字符定位，并输出 Markdown、SARIF 2.1.0 与 REP v1 证据记录；只做算术，不下指控。
items.descriptionEn: Recompute the statistics reported in a manuscript and flag self-inconsistent p values for DeepSeek Harness: APA-style t/F/chi-square/r/z parsing, two-tailed and upper-tail p values from zero-dependency distributions, CI-versus-p checks, exact character locators, Markdown and SARIF 2.1.0 output, and a REP v1 evidence record; arithmetic, not accusation.

items.name: 门店补货计算
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向门店零售的补货计算：按「日均销量 ×（补货周期 + 安全天数）− 当前库存 − 在途」算出每个 SKU 的目标缺口并向上取整到起订量，输出按 SKU 的补货建议、按门店汇总的补货单与补货 CSV，顺带标出滞销与缺货风险——纯本地、零运行时依赖、不联网、不下采购单。
items.descriptionEn: Replenishment maths for retail stores: compute each SKU's target gap as daily average × (cycle days + safety days) − stock − in-transit, round it up to the MOQ, and output per-SKU suggestions, per-store replenishment orders and a replenishment CSV while flagging slow-moving SKUs and stockout risk — local only, zero runtime dependencies, no network, no purchase order.

items.name: 流式折叠
items.author: rezon-aki
items.description: 在官方对话流上做展示增强：运行中自动展开最新的思考小窗、旧过程行折成一条摘要；一轮跑完把思考与工具调用折起，穿插正文保留。折叠按 3 行一组错峰、逐帧推进，不依赖历史是否加载完；折叠内容保持可搜索（hidden=until-found），Ctrl+F 仍能命中；跑完平滑回到你那一问。启用「折叠」档会接管官方「对话显示」设置：把官方 transcriptView 写成 verbose 并隐藏官方那一行；从本插件切回官方档会写回所选档，卸载后官方档停在「完全展开」，需要时到官方设置里改回。
items.descriptionEn: A display enhancement over the official transcript: while a turn runs, the newest thinking window opens itself and older process rows fold into one summary; at the end of a turn, thinking and tool calls fold away while interleaved prose stays. Folding advances per frame without waiting for history to load, folded rows stay searchable (hidden=until-found) so Ctrl+F still finds them, and a finished turn scrolls back to your question. While its Fold mode is active it takes over the official transcript display setting: the official transcriptView is parked on Verbose and that row is hidden. Switching back to an official mode from this plugin writes the chosen mode back; uninstalling leaves the official value on Verbose until it is changed in the official settings.

items.name: 收件箱侧边栏 (dsh-t3-inbox)
items.author: tungloong
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 T3 Code 风格注意力收件箱侧边栏插件：把运行中与待处理分区隔开，卡片直接显示明确状态文字（待批准/待输入/失败/受限/已唤醒/完成）与 Git 分支/worktree 信息，支持单点收尾、竖向扫选（Sweep）与 5 秒撤销、可编辑暂缓快捷选项与日历弹窗、高相关搜索、多选项目筛选、自动跟随第三方皮肤与 8 语言界面；仅写轻量插件元数据，随时可一键切回原生工作区视图。
items.descriptionEn: Attention-first, T3 Code-inspired inbox sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: separates running threads from what needs your decision, surfaces explicit status text (Approval/Input/Failed/Limited/Woke/Done) and Git branch/worktree context, and supports single Settle, vertical Sweep with 5s undo, customizable Snooze presets and calendar, ranked search, multi-select project filter, auto theme detection, and 8 languages - storing only lightweight plugin metadata with a one-click switch back to native Workspaces View.

items.name: 表格导入
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 把 .docx、.xlsx、.xlsm、.csv、.tsv 中的表格转换成规则核查器可读的 table JSON；识别不了时明确报告，不做猜测。
items.descriptionEn: Converts tables in .docx, .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv and .tsv files into the table JSON consumed by the rule checkers, and reports when it could not rather than guessing.

items.name: 语音交互
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 语音优先的会话环：输入框麦克风按钮接浏览器或本地语音识别，speak 工具朗读回复，事件播报可静音，说话即可打断。
items.descriptionEn: Voice-first session loop: a composer microphone button with browser or local speech-to-text, a speak tool for replies, event announcements with mute, and speak-to-interrupt.

items.name: 任务折叠
items.author: yindf
items.description: 把已完成的 agent 工作折叠成一条带标题的简短摘要，长会话保持可读、请求更省；每次折叠的原始内容随时可用 fold_recall 原样读回。
items.descriptionEn: Folds finished agent work into a short titled summary so long sessions stay readable and requests stay cheap; every fold's original content can be read back verbatim on demand.

items.name: 招标文件条款摘录核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向招标代理与投标专员的纯本地招标条款摘录核对：读一份招标文件条款摘录表，按随包的 7 条规则核对出处（条款编号）是否可定位、原文是否逐字照录、提炼要求是否与原文一致、类别是否取自取值口径、序号是否唯一、模板占位符是否残留，每条发现都带行号、字段与修改提示，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——不判合规、不认定责任，只提示差异，原件只读。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only tender clause-extract check for tender agents and bidders: read a tender clause-extract table and apply the seven versioned rules to verify that each source citation is locatable, the raw text is verbatim, the distilled requirement matches the source, categories come from the allowed vocabulary, sequence numbers are unique and no template placeholder survives — every finding names the row, the field and the fix; no compliance verdict and no liability finding — differences only, the original is read-only.

items.name: 评标矩阵核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向招标采购的纯本地评标评分矩阵核对：核对评标因素的分值上限、所记分值与合计之间的内部算术自洽性，在评审会前把矩阵里的算术错误逐行指出来——只列差异，不评价评标本身是否正确或公平，不替评标委员会下结论。
items.descriptionEn: Local-only bid-evaluation scoring-matrix check for tendering: verify that each factor's maximum, the scores recorded and the totals agree with each other, and point out the arithmetic errors row by row before the review meeting — differences only; it does not judge whether the evaluation was correct or fair and never stands in for the committee's verdict.

items.name: 招标要点提取
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 从招标文件提取截止时间、保证金、有效期、最高限价、投标文件组成与正副本份数；未找到的项也逐条报告，不省略。
items.descriptionEn: Extracts deadlines, deposit, validity, ceiling, bid composition and copy counts from a tender document, and reports the items it did not find rather than omitting them.

items.name: 隔离试驾
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 隔离安装冒烟：把仓库或 npm 包装进一次性 DSH_HOME profile，验证 bundle patch 层与启动日志，并记录结构化的通过/失败矩阵。
items.descriptionEn: Isolated install-and-smoke test drives: installs a repo or npm package into a throwaway DSH_HOME profile, verifies the bundle patch layer and boot logs, and records a structured pass/fail matrix.

items.name: 谢谢卡尔
items.author: gongfpp
items.description: DSH Web 刺猬卡尔桌宠，带 12 种预生成 AI 动作、摸摸互动、25/45 分钟专注、快捷菜单、可选边缘闲逛和本地喝水/吃饭/休息提醒。AI 动作不是原照片连拍，可关闭恢复原图；失败、取消和中断不庆祝，完成彩蛋默认概率 15%、冷却 30 分钟。不读聊天正文、不调用模型或系统通知，页面关闭不提醒，错过不补放。需 HTTPS 或 localhost 及 Web Locks；代码 MIT，照片及 AI 衍生素材仅限随插件个人非商用。
items.descriptionEn: A Carl hedgehog companion for DSH Web with 12 pre-generated AI sprite actions, pat reactions, a 25/45-minute focus timer, quick menu, optional edge wandering and local water/meal/break reminders. AI sprites are not photographic burst captures and can be disabled to restore the original photo. Failures, cancellations and interruptions are never celebrated; completion easter eggs default to 15% chance and a 30-minute cooldown. No conversation-content reads, runtime model calls or system notifications; runs only in an open page without replaying missed reminders. Requires HTTPS or localhost and Web Locks. Code is MIT; photos and AI-derived artwork are for personal, non-commercial use with this plugin only.

items.name: 天书 TUI
items.author: huiliyi37
items.description: 基于官方 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式终端 UI 插件，在官方基础上增加 TDD 与证据门等工作流。
items.descriptionEn: An interactive terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds TDD and evidence-gate workflows on top of the official base.

items.name: TRAE CN 反代与控制台
items.author: FuSheng-cs
items.description: TRAE CN 反代与内嵌控制台，支持自动签到、多账号管理和轮询、模型发现、思考档位及模型显示/隐藏。自动签到与轮询默认关闭；仅限有权使用且服务方允许的账号与功能，详见仓库免责声明。
items.descriptionEn: TRAE CN relay and embedded console with daily check-in, multiple accounts, rotation, model discovery, reasoning levels and visibility controls. Automation is off by default; account/service permission is required. See the repository disclaimer.

items.name: 参数翻译
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 厂商参数翻译与确定性 JSON 修复：/translate 在 11 家厂商间映射 temperature、top_p、max_tokens、stop 与 system，后置层修复损坏的 JSON 输出。
items.descriptionEn: Vendor parameter translation and deterministic JSON repair: /translate maps temperature, top_p, max_tokens, stop and system across eleven vendors, and the post-execute layer repairs broken JSON output.

items.name: 差旅费用核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的差旅费用核对：导入行程单、发票与卡流水，去重后做三单匹配与只读政策校验，输出可核对的台账——5 个 travel.* 工具。
items.descriptionEn: Travel expense reconciliation for DeepSeek Harness: ingest trip orders, invoices and card lines, deduplicate, run the three-way match and a read-only policy check, then export an audit-ready ledger - 5 travel.* tools.

items.name: 分诊台
items.author: jjjjjjjjnnjnn
items.description: 装前判断与装后归因：一条命令说明插件为什么从你的组合里消失。默认只读——不安装到你的 profile、不卸载、不判安全；只有显式 `--apply` 才改配置，先备份、可 `--undo` 逐字节还原。
items.descriptionEn: Pre-install judgement and post-install attribution: one command explains why a plugin disappeared from your composition. Read-only by default — it never installs into your profile, never removes, and never claims a plugin is safe; only an explicit `--apply` changes config, after a backup, and `--undo` restores the bytes.

items.name: dsh-TUI
items.author: ccch1mneyyy
items.description: Claude Code 风格全屏交互终端插件：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开、双击 Esc 回滚、上下文进度条与 TPS 仪表。
items.descriptionEn: A Claude Code style fullscreen interactive terminal plugin: pixel-whale header, live working-state line, streaming reasoning expansion, double-Esc rollback, context progress bar and TPS gauges.

items.name: TutorLoop 学习陪练
items.author: Qinling-Melon-Farmers
items.description: 围绕自选资料进行小步练习、证据反馈和 Leitner 间隔复习；18 个教师工具与中英双语学生面板，复用当前 DSH 会话模型，无需另配模型密钥。学习记录按工作区保存在本地，选用材料和作答可发送给宿主模型；主观反馈需核对。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0、Python 3.11+，安装后运行 dsh-tutorloop setup 配置 Python 依赖。内置 6 道自编示例题，真题库需自行导入。
items.descriptionEn: Guided practice over your materials, evidence-grounded feedback and Leitner spaced review, with 18 teacher tools and a Chinese/English student panel. Uses the current DSH session model without a separate model key. Learning records stay local per workspace; selected materials and answers may reach the host model, and subjective feedback needs review. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 and Python 3.11+; run dsh-tutorloop setup after installation for Python dependencies. Includes six original example exercises; users must import past-exam question banks themselves.

items.name: 地址栏深链
items.author: DDDMUC
items.description: 给 DSH 的每个界面一个自己的链接：会话（可带它所在的工作区）、主面板与面板里的插件页 / 组件页、任务看板的任务与新建表单、设置三层（浮层 / 分区 / 页签）、会话内视图、轮次、轨迹行、右栏 pane 都写进地址栏；粘贴链接就打开那个界面，轮次链接还会先把历史翻页回那一轮、再滚到它。侧边栏会话行本身是真链接，浏览器原生的右键菜单、中键与 Ctrl/Cmd 点击照常可用；点击某一行或某一轮只把位置反映进地址栏，不拦截点击。链接落地前，挡在前面的主面板或设置浮层会先让开。Windows 桌面版把它画进标题栏那条空白；macOS 桌面版把它放进会话标题行里最宽的一段空白，两侧握把可拖动调宽、宽度按窗口比例记住，回车后没落地会标红并写明原因。地址栏的唯一写者：只写 fragment、只用 replaceState，路径与查询串原样保留，任何一步都不抛异常；遇到别的插件写的 fragment 只报告一次、绝不覆盖；路由健康报告见 window.__dshUrlRouter.report()。
items.descriptionEn: Give every surface of DSH its own link: a conversation (optionally with the workspace it lives in), the main panel and the plugin and component pages inside it, task-board tasks and the new-task form, settings at all three levels (overlay, section, tab), conversation views, turns, trajectory rows and right-bar panes all land in the address bar, and pasting a link opens that surface - a turn link pages history back to the turn before scrolling to it. Sidebar conversation rows become real anchors, so the native context menu, middle-click and Ctrl/Cmd-click keep working; clicking a row or a turn only reflects the position and never intercepts the click. Before a link lands, a main panel or a settings overlay standing in front steps aside. The desktop app has no address bar of its own: on Windows the plugin draws one into the empty title-bar strip, on macOS into the widest gap in the session header row, with edge grips to resize it and the width remembered as a window ratio; a link that fails to land turns red with the reason written out. Sole writer of the address bar: fragment-only through replaceState, path and query untouched, no step throws; a fragment written by another plugin is reported once and never overwritten; window.__dshUrlRouter.report() exposes a route health report.

items.name: 消耗统计面板
items.author: AlfredChaos
items.description: 设置页 Token 用量统计：累计 KPI 与侧边栏会话列表同口径、半年活跃热力图、按模型堆叠的每日柱状图、模型环形图、Top 会话与 provider 分布，支持 JSON/CSV 导出。基于投影增量聚合、只读重算会话日志；fork/seed 历史去重、resume 会话完整保留、子代理消耗独立归属——历史账单的准确记账，与实时监控类插件互补。
items.descriptionEn: A Settings-page token usage panel for DSH: cumulative KPIs aligned with the visible session list, a six-month activity heatmap, per-model stacked daily bars, a model donut, top sessions and provider breakdown, with JSON/CSV export. Incremental projection over session logs, strictly read-only; fork/seed history deduplicated, resumed sessions kept whole, subagent spend attributed separately — authoritative historical accounting, complementary to live monitoring plugins.

items.name: DSH 版本守卫
items.author: skyjjgw
items.description: 记录插件版本与 profile 配置快照；插件冲突导致 DSH 无法启动时，通过独立恢复页回退到已知可用配置。支持单插件停用、恢复启用、版本锁定和显式依赖同步，不回退 DSH 应用本身。
items.descriptionEn: Snapshots plugin versions and profile configuration. An independent recovery page restores a known-good configuration when plugin conflicts prevent DSH from starting. Supports disabling and re-enabling plugins, version pinning, and explicit dependency synchronization; it does not roll back the DSH application.

items.name: 硬件监视
items.author: JoblessJoe
items.description: btop 风格的实时硬件监视：会话标题栏中的 CPU / GPU 迷你小组件（点击打开完整视图），以及 Chat / Trajectory 旁边的 Hardware 标签页：CPU 总负载、60 秒走势和每核负载、内存、CPU 温度，以及每块 NVIDIA GPU 的温度、负载、功耗和显存（通过 nvidia-smi）。已在 Linux 上实测；macOS 和 Windows 的读取逻辑目前仅用样例输出测试过。每项信号使用系统提供的免特权数据源，没有时自动隐藏。零运行时依赖，无需配置。
items.descriptionEn: Live btop-style hardware monitor: a CPU / GPU mini widget in the session header (click opens the full view) and a Hardware tab next to Chat / Trajectory with overall CPU load, a 60 s sparkline and per-core load, memory, CPU temperature, and per NVIDIA GPU temperature, load, power draw and VRAM (via nvidia-smi). Tested live on Linux; the macOS and Windows readers are only checked against sample output so far. Each signal uses an unprivileged OS source and hides itself when there is none. Zero runtime dependencies, no config.

items.name: 壁纸引擎
items.author: elysia395
items.description: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸渲染到 DSH 聊天界面后方：Scene/Web 由内置 WebWallGL 实时渲染，Video 直接播放；附液态玻璃、壁纸属性面板、Now Playing 联动与主题随壁纸。与皮肤类插件互斥（二选一）。
items.descriptionEn: Renders local Wallpaper Engine wallpapers behind the DSH chat UI: Scene/Web via the bundled WebWallGL renderer, Video plays directly, with liquid glass, a wallpaper properties panel, Now Playing integration and theme following. Mutually exclusive with skin plugins (choose one).

items.name: 质保期与索赔金额核对
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: 面向合同管理与质保结算的纯本地质保期与索赔金额核对：依据《家用汽车产品修理更换退货责任规定》（市场监管总局令第43号），读取一份质保索赔台账，逐条核对质保期月数与里程是否在限值内、销售日期与索赔日期是否可解析且先后成立、索赔金额算式是否自洽、台账写明的截止日期是否已过，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单与修法——不判断索赔是否应当受理、故障是否属于质保范围；只提示差异，不作出定性结论，原件只读。
